Definition: to hop, i.e. (figuratively) skip over (or spare); by implication, to hesitate; also (literally) to limp, to dance
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pass over, spring over; 1a) (Qal) to pass over; 1b) (Piel) to skip, pass over; 2) to limp; 2a) (Qal) to limp; 2b) (Niphal) to be lame; 2c) (Piel) to limp
